sources.title: Python math.isqrt documentation
sources.enterprise_use: Adopts the greatest-integer inequality characterization of integer square root; Enterprise Math does not require the hidden-real floor interpretation as primitive.
sources.not_claimed: Integer square root itself is not novel.

sources.title: Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Floor.Div
sources.enterprise_use: Uses the order-theoretic view of flooring division as a right adjoint: the greatest integer state satisfying an inequality.
sources.not_claimed: Floor/ceiling division and its Galois-adjoint formulation are established mathematics.

sources.title: Mathlib.Order.Closure
sources.enterprise_use: Provides the established language of monotone, idempotent closure/interior-style operators and their connection with Galois adjoints.
sources.not_claimed: Closure/interior operators and Galois connections are not novel.

sources.title: Integer Representation of Decimal Numbers for Exact Computations
sources.enterprise_use: Shows exact additions, subtractions and multiplications after representing decimal inputs by integers at a prescribed scale.
sources.not_claimed: Scaled-integer arithmetic is not novel; Enterprise Math changes the foundational interpretation.

sources.title: Multigrid Methods Using Block Floating Point Arithmetic
sources.enterprise_use: Provides modern scaled-fixed-point/block-floating examples where integer matrix/vector operations can be exact up to specified precision.
sources.not_claimed: Integer-plus-scale numerical formats are not novel.

sources.title: Implementing exact real arithmetic in python, C++ and C
sources.enterprise_use: Demonstrates scaled-integer exact-real computation; used as a contrast because it retains exact real numbers as the target semantics.
sources.not_claimed: Scaled-integer exact-real arithmetic is not Enterprise Math's invention.

sources.title: FLINT qqbar: algebraic numbers represented by minimal polynomials
sources.enterprise_use: Shows that algebraic numbers can be represented exactly by finite integer polynomial data plus an isolating interval.
sources.not_claimed: Finite exact symbolic representation of algebraic numbers is established; Enterprise Math questions the hidden real-number ontology rather than representation alone.

sources.title: Sage elements optimized for quadratic number fields
sources.enterprise_use: Shows exact quadratic-field elements represented internally by integer triples.
sources.not_claimed: Integer encodings of algebraic extensions are established mathematics/software.

sources.title: Indeterminism in Physics, Classical Chaos and Bohmian Mechanics. Are Real Numbers Really Real?
sources.enterprise_use: Provides a prior physical argument that infinite-information real numbers should not automatically be treated as physically real and proposes finite-information numbers.
sources.not_claimed: The critique of physically instantiated infinite-precision reals is prior work.

sources.title: Physics without Determinism: Alternative Interpretations of Classical Physics
sources.enterprise_use: Names the principle of infinite precision and develops finite-information quantities as an alternative classical interpretation.
sources.not_claimed: Finite-information critiques of classical real-number ontology are prior work.

sources.title: Quantized Space-Time
sources.enterprise_use: Provides an early explicit example of Lorentz-invariant discrete spacetime.
sources.not_claimed: Discrete spacetime is not novel to Enterprise Math.

sources.title: Space-time as a causal set
sources.enterprise_use: Provides a locally finite partially ordered spacetime model and a continuum-approximation direction.
sources.not_claimed: Local finiteness, causal-set order, and discrete spacetime are established prior ideas.

sources.title: Irreversibility and Heat Generation in the Computing Process
sources.enterprise_use: Provides the classic link between logical functions lacking a single-valued inverse and physical dissipation.
sources.not_claimed: Logical irreversibility and its thermodynamic study are prior work; Enterprise Math does not treat its ontological collapse as ordinary information erasure by default.

sources.title: Logical Reversibility of Computation
sources.enterprise_use: Shows how computation can preserve intermediate history and be made logically reversible.
sources.not_claimed: Reversible computation is prior work; Enterprise Math tests whether nature itself need not preserve a reversible completion.

sources.title: Memory Effects in Irreversible Thermodynamics
sources.enterprise_use: Provides an exact projection-based route to irreversible macroscopic equations with memory effects.
sources.not_claimed: Projection-based derivation of macro-irreversibility from finer dynamics is prior work and is a major contrast class.

sources.title: Transport, Collective Motion, and Brownian Motion
sources.enterprise_use: Develops projection/operator methods for macroscopic stochastic and transport descriptions.
sources.not_claimed: Mori-Zwanzig projection methods are established; Enterprise Math tests a stronger fundamentally many-to-one ontology.

sources.title: Preimage entropy for mappings
sources.enterprise_use: Part of the established program quantifying non-invertibility through preimage structure.
sources.not_claimed: Preimage entropy is not novel.

sources.title: Pre-image entropy
sources.enterprise_use: Defines preimage entropy invariants intended to quantify how far a map is from invertibility.
sources.not_claimed: Entropy based on preimage structure is established prior work.

sources.title: Positivity of entropy production in nonequilibrium statistical mechanics
sources.enterprise_use: Introduces folding-entropy ideas in the study of entropy production for non-invertible dynamics.
sources.not_claimed: Folding entropy and its relation to entropy production are prior work.

sources.title: On preimage entropy, folding entropy and stable entropy
sources.enterprise_use: Explicitly studies how non-invertibility contributes to entropy and relates preimage entropy to folding entropy under stated conditions.
sources.not_claimed: The connection between preimages, non-invertibility and entropy has an established literature.

sources.title: Completely positive dynamical semigroups of N-level systems
sources.enterprise_use: Provides a canonical physical use of forward dynamical semigroups in Markovian open quantum evolution.
sources.not_claimed: Forward semigroup descriptions in physics are established; this formalism is not Enterprise Math's model.

sources.title: On the generators of quantum dynamical semigroups
sources.enterprise_use: Provides another canonical mathematical characterization of forward quantum dynamical semigroups.
sources.not_claimed: Semigroup time evolution in open quantum systems is prior work and does not establish fundamental ontological collapse.

sources.title: On the foundations of combinatorial theory I. Theory of Möbius functions
sources.enterprise_use: Provides the established Möbius-inversion and incidence-algebra language used to express signed overlap cancellation on divisor lattices.
sources.not_claimed: Möbius inversion, incidence algebras, and Boolean-lattice Möbius functions are established mathematics.

sources.title: On the Existence of Integers with at Most 3 Prime Factors Between Every Pair of Consecutive Squares
sources.enterprise_use: Provides the current explicit almost-prime benchmark between every pair of consecutive squares and documents limitations of the weighted-sieve route toward fewer prime factors.
sources.not_claimed: Enterprise Math does not claim Campbell's almost-prime theorem, its finite verification, or the weighted-sieve methods used there.

sources.title: An algorithm and computation to verify Legendre's conjecture up to 7*10^13
sources.enterprise_use: Provides the published computational verification of Oppermann's conjecture, and therefore Legendre's conjecture, through n=7.05*10^13.
sources.not_claimed: Finite verification is established prior work and does not prove Legendre's conjecture for all n.

sources.title: Surviving Eratosthenes sieve I: quadratic density and Legendre's conjecture
sources.enterprise_use: Provides independent prior work that explicitly studies Eratosthenes sieve as a discrete dynamical system and introduces quadratic-density models for consecutive-square intervals.
sources.not_claimed: Dynamic-sieve language and square-interval survival models are not unique to Enterprise Math; Holt's expected-density framework does not establish Legendre's conjecture.

sources.title: Threshold complexes and connections to number theory
sources.enterprise_use: Provides the established scalar quota/threshold-complex framework, the bouquet-of-spheres shell theorem, and the LogPrime construction where logarithmic prime weights turn multiplicative thresholds into simplicial-complex quotas. The Legendre cutoff-crossing divisors are an integer presentation of the corresponding shell faces on a finite prime support.
sources.not_claimed: Quota/threshold complexes, LogPrime topology, Euler-characteristic/Mobius connections, and the shell-face bouquet theorem are established prior work; Enterprise Math only studies how its integer-root cutoff hierarchy interacts with this structure in the square-basin pressure test.

sources.title: Combinatorial Alexander Duality — a Short and Elementary Proof
sources.enterprise_use: Provides the established finite simplicial-complex Alexander duality relating reduced homology in degree i to reduced cohomology of the Alexander dual in degree |V|-i-3. Enterprise Math applies it to the exact multiplicative threshold dual K(G,T)^*=K(G,floor((G-1)/T)).
sources.not_claimed: Combinatorial Alexander duality and its homology/cohomology dimension reversal are established mathematics; the project only studies the square-basin half-scale specialization and its interaction with integer-root shells.

sources.title: The Stacks Project, Section 12.19: Filtrations
sources.enterprise_use: Provides established filtered-object and successive-layer language against which P018 precision chains and shell decompositions are compared.
sources.not_claimed: Filtered objects, induced/quotient filtrations, associated graded constructions, and layerwise algebra are established mathematics; P018 does not claim them as inventions.

sources.title: A Theory for Multiresolution Signal Decomposition: The Wavelet Representation
sources.enterprise_use: Provides the established multiresolution idea that information differences between adjacent resolutions can be isolated as separate detail components.
sources.not_claimed: Multiresolution analysis, nested approximation spaces, wavelet detail spaces, and extracting information differences between resolutions are established prior work.

sources.title: IEEE Standard for Interval Arithmetic
sources.enterprise_use: Provides an established rigorous finite-enclosure arithmetic in which operations propagate interval information and can support certified numerical conclusions.
sources.not_claimed: Interval arithmetic, outward-enclosure semantics, certified finite-precision computation, and refinement of enclosures are established; P018 differs by treating finite integer precision states as the primary state semantics rather than enclosures of hidden real values.

sources.title: Tracking p-adic precision
sources.enterprise_use: Provides an established method for propagating p-adic precision through computations, including precision structures richer than naive digit counts in the authors' subsequent work.
sources.not_claimed: p-adic precision propagation, ultrametric precision models, and their computational stability theory are established; P018 does not claim them as new.

sources.title: Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Metric
sources.enterprise_use: Provides established shortest-walk graph distance, extended distance for disconnected vertices, adjacency at distance one, symmetry and triangle laws used as the formal prior-art foundation for P012.
sources.not_claimed: Shortest-path graph metrics and their formalization are established mathematics; P012 does not claim invention of graph distance.

sources.title: Optical clock comparison for Lorentz symmetry testing
sources.enterprise_use: Provides a high-precision Lorentz-symmetry benchmark for concrete finite-resolution realizations that predict unavoidable preferred-direction or rotational-anisotropy signals.
sources.not_claimed: This experiment does not directly test Enterprise Math or generic discreteness; it constrains only concrete realizations that map their parameters to the tested Lorentz-violation observables.

sources.title: A limit on the variation of the speed of light arising from quantum gravity effects
authors: A. A. Abdo et al. (Fermi collaborations)
sources.enterprise_use: Provides a long-baseline propagation benchmark for concrete models that necessarily predict energy-dependent photon speed or modified dispersion.
sources.not_claimed: GRB 090510 does not exclude finite resolution in general; it constrains realizations with the tested energy-dependent propagation effect.

sources.title: Quantum superposition of molecules beyond 25 kDa
sources.enterprise_use: Provides a matter-wave interference benchmark relevant to concrete fundamental-collapse realizations that predict unavoidable loss of coherence for massive superpositions.
sources.not_claimed: The experiment does not directly test Enterprise Math collapse; a quantitative map from an Enterprise Math physical realization to fringe visibility is required first.

sources.title: Bounds on quantum collapse models from matter-wave interferometry: calculational details
sources.enterprise_use: Provides established methodology for translating matter-wave interference data into exclusion regions for objective-collapse models, used as a comparison class for P016 coherence kill tests.
sources.not_claimed: Collapse-model exclusion machinery and matter-wave constraints are prior work; P016 does not claim them as Enterprise Math inventions.

sources.title: CSL Collapse Model Mapped with the Spontaneous Radiation
sources.enterprise_use: Provides an established spontaneous-radiation exclusion strategy for concrete nonunitary collapse models with unavoidable radiative output.
sources.not_claimed: Spontaneous-radiation tests of CSL are established prior work and do not directly constrain an Enterprise Math realization until it predicts a corresponding radiation channel.

sources.title: Bulk heating effects as tests for collapse models
sources.enterprise_use: Provides established bulk-heating constraints for collapse-noise models and a benchmark for P016 realizations that necessarily inject energy.
sources.not_claimed: Bulk-heating tests of collapse models are prior work; Enterprise Math must derive its own quantitative heating law before comparison.

sources.title: Gravity-related collapse of the wave function and spontaneous heating: Revisiting the experimental bounds
sources.enterprise_use: Provides a benchmark analysis of spontaneous-heating constraints on Diósi-Penrose-type collapse models, including low-temperature heat-leak tests.
sources.not_claimed: These bounds concern specific gravity-related collapse models, not generic finite-resolution or many-to-one dynamics.

sources.title: Test of Electric Charge Conservation with Borexino
sources.enterprise_use: Provides an experimental benchmark for concrete many-to-one realizations that necessarily permit charge-nonconserving electron decay channels.
sources.not_claimed: Charge-conservation limits do not imply that generic fundamental collapse violates charge; only realizations predicting the tested channel are constrained.

sources.title: Variants of the Selberg sieve, and bounded intervals containing many primes
sources.enterprise_use: Provides the established unconditional bound H_1<=246 for the liminf of consecutive prime gaps. P018 Stage 8 translates this prior result into the factor-proof-slack corollary liminf sigma(k)<=122.
sources.not_claimed: The bound 246, bounded-gap sieve methods, and any prime-gap theorem are not Enterprise Math results; only the finite-precision translation is project-specific and novelty-unverified.
